violations.description: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds
Ensure every HTML document has a lang attribute
Ensure elements have alternative text or a role of none or presentation
Ensure every form element has a label
Ensure the document has a main landmark
Ensure that the page, or at least one of its frames contains a level-one heading
Ensure all page content is contained by landmarks
